set -euo pipefail
# The whole run lives in /tmp/run.py (emptyDir — the root fs is read-only): bearer
# substitution, a Peloton session preflight, then ytdl-sub with every line it prints
# scrubbed of the Authorization bearer. Rationale in the docstring (#2908, #2909).
cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/run.py
"""ytdl-sub-peloton run wrapper: substitute the bearer, PROVE the session works, then
run ytdl-sub with the bearer scrubbed from everything it prints.

Why this exists (haynes-ops #2908 / #2909):
  * ytdl-sub's per-subscription exception handler dumps the whole yt-dlp argument
    dict — Authorization header included — at ERROR level, so `--log-level=info`
    (the July fix, #2198) never covered it. Every line ytdl-sub prints now passes
    through a redactor before it reaches stdout/Loki.
  * When yt-dlp cannot extract a class, its `ignoreerrors` swallows the failure on
    every class: 177 subscriptions report "done, 0 new" and only the odd one raises.
    The Job looked like "one bad class"; it was weeks of downloading nothing (the
    cause turned out to be Peloton's manifest signing, not the session —
    ytdrivarr#40). The preflight below runs yt-dlp's full extraction (session ->
    metadata -> signed stream URL -> manifest) against a few real classes and
    refuses to start the 4h run when all of them fail.
  * With the session proven, a handful of classes failing (pulled from the library,
    a yt-dlp hiccup) must not fail the whole run — but a large share must.
"""

import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

TOKEN_PATH = '/media/peloton/bearer.txt'
COOKIES_PATH = '/media/peloton/cookies.txt'
SUBS_IN = '/media/peloton/subscriptions.yaml'
SUBS_OUT = '/config/subscriptions.yaml'
CONFIG = '/config/config.yaml'
# Same headers the subscriptions preset gives yt-dlp (http_headers).
HEADERS = [
    'Origin: https://members.onepeloton.com',
    'Referer: https://members.onepeloton.com/',
]
PREFLIGHT_PROBES = 3
# Share of subscriptions allowed to fail before the run counts as failed.
TOLERATED_FAILURE_SHARE = 0.10

BEGIN_RE = re.compile(r'^\[ytdl-sub\] Beginning subscription download for (.+)$')
FAILED_RE = re.compile(r'^\[ytdl-sub\] The following error occurred for the subscription (.+):$')
BEARER_RE = re.compile(r'Bearer [A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]{16,}')
DOWNLOAD_RE = re.compile(r'^\s*download:\s*(https://members\.onepeloton\.com/classes/player/\S+)')


def log(msg):
    print(f'[wrapper] {msg}', flush=True)


def die(msg, code=1):
    log(msg)
    sys.exit(code)


def read_token():
    try:
        token = open(TOKEN_PATH).read().strip()
    except OSError as exc:
        die(f'cannot read {TOKEN_PATH}: {exc}')
    if not token:
        die(f'{TOKEN_PATH} is empty')
    return token


def render_subscriptions(token):
    """ytdrivarr projects subscriptions.yaml with a literal placeholder; fill it in."""
    try:
        content = open(SUBS_IN).read()
    except OSError as exc:
        die(f'cannot read {SUBS_IN}: {exc}')
    placeholder = '$' + '{PELOTON_BEARER}'  # built in parts: keep it out of Flux/Helm substitution
    if placeholder not in content:
        die(f'{SUBS_IN} carries no {placeholder} placeholder — is ytdrivarr projecting the right file?')
    try:
        with open(SUBS_OUT, 'w') as handle:
            handle.write(content.replace(placeholder, token))
    except OSError as exc:
        die(f'cannot write {SUBS_OUT}: {exc}')
    return [m.group(1) for line in content.splitlines() if (m := DOWNLOAD_RE.match(line))]


def make_redactor(token):
    def redact(line):
        if token:
            line = line.replace(token, '<REDACTED>')
        return BEARER_RE.sub('Bearer <REDACTED>', line)
    return redact


def preflight(token, urls, redact):
    """Run yt-dlp's full extraction (started_client_session -> ride details -> signed
    stream URL -> manifest formats) against a few real classes. Any one succeeding proves
    the path; all failing means every class would fail exactly like this, so the run is
    pointless."""
    if not urls:
        die('preflight: no class URLs found in the projected subscriptions')
    # first / middle / last: spread the probes across the library
    picks = sorted({urls[0], urls[len(urls) // 2], urls[-1]})[:PREFLIGHT_PROBES]
    minted = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime(os.path.getmtime(TOKEN_PATH)))
    for url in picks:
        # No --ignore-no-formats-error: it turns a manifest 403 into a silent pass,
        # which hid ytdrivarr#40. bearer.txt already carries its `Bearer ` scheme —
        # the same value render_subscriptions() drops into the Authorization header.
        cmd = ['yt-dlp', '--simulate', '--quiet', '--no-warnings',
               '--print', 'id', '--cookies', COOKIES_PATH]
        for header in HEADERS + ['Authorization: ' + token]:
            cmd += ['--add-header', header]
        cmd.append(url)
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            log(f'preflight: {url} timed out')
            continue
        if result.returncode == 0:
            log(f'preflight: Peloton session accepted (bearer.txt minted {minted}; probe {url})')
            return
        tail = (result.stderr.strip().splitlines() or [f'exit {result.returncode}'])[-1]
        log(f'preflight: {url} -> {redact(tail)}')
    die(f'preflight: yt-dlp could not extract any of {len(picks)} probe classes (bearer.txt '
        f'minted {minted}). Not starting ytdl-sub — every class would fail the same way. Fix '
        f'it on the ytdrivarr side (worker session mint, or the projected yt-dlp plugins), '
        f'not here.', 2)


def log_plugins():
    found = []
    for root in filter(None, os.environ.get('PYTHONPATH', '').split(':')):
        extractor_dir = os.path.join(root, 'yt_dlp_plugins', 'extractor')
        if os.path.isdir(extractor_dir):
            found += sorted(f for f in os.listdir(extractor_dir) if f.endswith('.py'))
    log(f'yt-dlp plugins projected by ytdrivarr: {", ".join(found) or "NONE (built-in extractors only)"}')


def run_ytdl_sub(redact):
    cmd = ['ytdl-sub', '--log-level=info', f'--config={CONFIG}', 'sub', SUBS_OUT]
    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONUNBUFFERED='1')
    proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                            text=True, errors='replace', env=env)
    started, failed = [], []
    for line in proc.stdout:
        line = line.rstrip('\n')
        if m := BEGIN_RE.match(line):
            started.append(m.group(1))
        elif m := FAILED_RE.match(line):
            failed.append(m.group(1))
        print(redact(line), flush=True)
    return proc.wait(), started, failed


def main():
    token = read_token()
    redact = make_redactor(token)
    urls = render_subscriptions(token)
    log_plugins()
    preflight(token, urls, redact)
    rc, started, failed = run_ytdl_sub(redact)
    if rc == 0:
        log(f'ytdl-sub finished: {len(started)} subscriptions, 0 failed')
        return 0
    tolerated = max(1, int(len(started) * TOLERATED_FAILURE_SHARE))
    if started and len(failed) <= tolerated:
        log(f'WARNING: ytdl-sub exit {rc} — {len(failed)}/{len(started)} subscription(s) failed '
            f'(tolerating up to {tolerated}): ' + '; '.join(failed))
        log('treating the run as a partial success; the session preflight passed, so these '
            'are per-class failures, not a dead downloader')
        return 0
    log(f'ytdl-sub exit {rc} — {len(failed)}/{len(started)} subscription(s) failed, above the '
        f'tolerated {tolerated}: ' + '; '.join(failed[:10]))
    return rc or 1


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
EOF
exec python3 /tmp/run.py
until pg_isready -h openproject-db-rw.frontend.svc.cluster.local -U openproject >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 2; done; exec /app/docker/prod/seeder

case "$HEADER_SECRET" in ''|*[!0-9a-fA-F]*) echo 'HEADER_SECRET must be hexadecimal' >&2; exit 1;; esac; test "${#HEADER_SECRET}" -eq 64 || { echo 'HEADER_SECRET must contain 64 hex characters' >&2; exit 1; }; umask 077; mkdir -p /tmp/client_body /tmp/proxy /tmp/fastcgi /tmp/uwsgi /tmp/scgi; sed "s/@@HEADER_SECRET@@/$HEADER_SECRET/g" /config/nginx.conf.template > /tmp/nginx.conf; nginx -t -c /tmp/nginx.conf; exec nginx -c /tmp/nginx.conf -g 'daemon off;'
